scope: Complete pinned tests/fixtures inventory, full directories and standalone original file inputs, including no-SKILL inputs and registry mode. No injected SKILL.md for upstream inputs. Not all pytest/inline variants, independent malware quality, live models, online registry/OSV, signature verification or whole-product parity.

normalization.method: Family/file sets; raw reports retain original IDs, severity, locations, expected rejection stderr and coverage. Registry posture reports have no source-line field; path is the original input basename, not an invented line. Own Scout checks remain distinct. Scores/verdict/coverage not normalized.

reasons.lp-empty-vs-absent: Upstream LP3 corresponds to Scout LP1 with explicit permissions: []; absence and explicit empty scope remain distinct.
reasons.lp-evidence-location: Scout LP1 cites manifest plus related captured code evidence; upstream locates the code file.
reasons.padding-covered: Scout P9 detects the same long whitespace; no second MP2 charge is needed for the same padding observation.
reasons.credential-covered: Scout FS001 detects the HOME credential-path reference, including decoded scalar evidence; not a proven read.
reasons.emoji-control: The fixture uses an ordinary valid emoji ZWJ sequence; do not copy the upstream Unicode anomaly on this benign control.
reasons.overwritten-taint: The value is overwritten by a public constant before the sink; Scout invalidates taint.
reasons.shadowed-codec: A local safe codec class shadows the pickle module; neither unsafe deserialization nor TT6 is established.
reasons.docker-option: The Docker command has no image operand; upstream treats --disable-content-trust=... as the image.
reasons.path-mention: A manifest index mentions peer skill paths without a read/enumeration instruction; Scout keeps AS3 narrower.
reasons.walk-docstring: Upstream E3 matches the generic docstring Walk directory, without a sensitive filesystem target; Scout requires sensitive enumeration evidence.
reasons.no-code-unused: A tool-using instruction package has no code files; this does not prove its declared capabilities are unused. Scout AC002 still flags the wildcard.
reasons.osv-not-selected: Upstream emits an offline OSV fallback coverage warning without a matched advisory; Scout vulnerability inspection is explicitly unselected.
